title: nf-core/oncotrseq pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

project.errorMessage: Project ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces

input.errorMessage: pod5, fastq and bam file path must be provided

ubam.errorMessage: Absolute path to ubam file path must be provided

ref_genome.errorMessage: Reference genome type must be provided and be either hg38|GRCh38 or hg19|GRCh37

ref_genome_path.errorMessage: Glob of path to reference genome fasta and index file must be provided

ref_transcriptome.errorMessage: Reference transcriptome type must be provided and be named as Gencode49 or GRCh38-104, or any other reference used

ref_transcriptome_path.errorMessage: Glob of path to reference transcriptome fasta and gtf file must be provided

kit.errorMessage: Valid Barcoding Nanopore kit must be provided
